title: VXAce How to hide game assets from normal people?

posts.author: Jestingtank
posts.body:
I am trying to export my game (I have create encrypted archive enabled) but after I click the exe and it uncompresses the game it keeps the other assets like sounds and graphics visible to anyone. How do I make it so they can't easily see these?
I do not need anything fancy just something simple to prevent normal people.
Edit: The graphics just seem to be the default but the audio I put in is not encrypted.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
In RMXP, VX, and VXAce, it was never possible to encrypt audio files without using third-party tools.

How to encrypt music files? (RPG Maker VX Ace)

posts.author: JGreene
posts.body: I used Enigma Virtual Box for one of my demos a long time ago. Something like that might help, since it just compacts the game into an exe file. But, still, the most determined people will still be able to extract what they want. The normal user won't.
